capabilities: Run JavaScript from freeform code blocks in sandboxed iframes
Import ESM modules from URLs via esm.sh, jsdelivr, or unpkg
Display values and elements with display()
Fetch and inline external stylesheets into rendered output
disambiguation: Not a freeform drawing or canvas tool; it runs JavaScript code blocks inside notes.
extras: The README states there is no Observable-style reactivity, exports have no effect, only HTTP ESM imports are supported, and JSX is not yet supported; some stylesheets fetched via the CSP workaround will not resolve relative images or nested @import rules.
problem: Obsidian code blocks cannot execute arbitrary JavaScript or render live, interactive output inside a note.

relations.evidence: This brings a taste of Observable to Obsidian.

summary: JavaScript code blocks that run in sandboxed iframes, letting notes embed live programs, imported ESM modules, and visualizations.
